name: loop-breaker
description: Stops the model repeating the same tool call over and over: after N identical calls in a row it refuses the next one and tells the model to change approach.

maxRepeats.title: Identical calls allowed in a row
maxRepeats.description: The call after this many identical ones is refused

allowlist.title: Calls that may repeat
allowlist.description: Comma-separated tool names or Bash command prefixes never counted as a loop (polling calls)
